ahead.b: A permanent home of our own
ahead.t: After more than 25 years of renting, The Life Link purchased a new main building. Community support, housing, psychiatry, and Treat First services move under one roof in September 2026.
Growing our low-barrier micro-community shelter model so more people can move from the street to stability.
Planning for a potential application to become a Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic — the national model for comprehensive community care.
